title: Wisconsin, NY authorities criticize Circle for refusing to aid fraud recovery
summary: Law enforcement authorities in the U.S. states of Wisconsin and New York have criticized Circle (CRCL) for refusing to recover funds for fraud victims despite court orders, the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists (ICIJ) reported. Wisconsin prosecutors have filed criminal charges against Circle for allegedly refusing to execute a warrant to recover $381,000 in assets from a fraud case. Separately, New York prosecutors sent a letter of protest to the Senate, alleging that Circle is refusing to return over $119 million in frozen assets to keep the interest earned on them. Circle has claimed it is technically impossible to freeze and reissue USDC, a stance that has drawn comparisons to Tether, which has cooperated with similar investigations by burning and reissuing $1.1 billion in USDT.

title: Crypto industry accelerates shift to quantum-resistant tech, Reuters reports
summary: The cryptocurrency industry is preparing to transition its blockchain networks to post-quantum cryptography amid forecasts that quantum computers could advance faster than expected, Reuters reported. Google predicted in March that quantum computers could potentially break current encryption standards by 2029. Citigroup has also analyzed that the development of quantum computing and AI could make cryptocurrencies vulnerable to hacking sooner than anticipated. Reuters noted that while the industry is concerned about the burdens of an early transition, organizations like the Ethereum Foundation and the Algorand Foundation have already announced roadmaps to support post-quantum systems.
